author: GameTrailers
description:
Here's your look at the Dracula: The Disciple announcement trailer for this upcoming puzzle adventure game from Cyanide Studio. In Dracula: The Disciple, occult knowledge is your only path to immortality. Dracula: The Disciple will be available on PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X/S, and Steam.

Play as Emile Valombres, a dying French archivist drawn to Dracula’s abandoned stronghold in search of a cure. Explore a Gothic castle filled with mystical puzzles, forbidden experiments, alchemical secrets and dark rituals left behind by the Count himself.

Master occult tools, grow supernatural ingredients, perform ancient rites and uncover the truth behind vampiric transformation. But salvation comes at a terrible price… To cheat death, you must become something else.
title: Dracula: The Disciple - Official Announcement Trailer | Nacon Connect 2026

author: GameTrailers
description:
Get a behind-the-scenes look at Hunter: The Reckoning – Deathwish in this video as the Teyon development team gives a deep dive into the gameplay mechanics shaping your fight for survival in the upcoming action RPG. Sharpen your instincts. Trust your allies. Survive the night.

In the bustling streets of New York, passersby are unaware of the evil lurking in the shadows. You, however, know. Hunt the creatures of the World of Darkness in this action RPG, where your choices determine whether you live another day. 

Hunter: The Reckoning - Deathwish will be available on Xbox, Steam, and PlayStation 5 (PS5) in summer 2027.
title: Hunter: The Reckoning - Deathwish - Official Developer Diary: 'Pillars of The Hunt' Video

author: GameTrailers
description:
Galeao is a fictional track created with the help of professional GT3, LMP2 and LMPH drivers in the country of Brazil. Take a look at the Galeao track as a new circuit located in Brazil arrives for Endurance: Motorsport Series. Watch the latest Endurance: Motorsport Series to see this track, which was designed by the KT Racing teams. 

Endurance Motorsport Series immerses you in the heart of this unique experience: get behind the wheel as a driver, but also step into the shoes of the race engineer to make crucial decisions from the pit lane. 

Endurance Motorsport Series will be available on PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam).
title: Endurance: Motorsport Series - Official Galeao Track Trailer | Nacon Connect 2026

author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out the Dragonkin: The Banished Community Accolade trailer for the action hack-and-slash adventure RPG. Aid humanity in the fight from extinction as dragons roam and rule over the world. Journey to slay the Dragon Lords using powerful abilities, varied gear, and a variety of deadly weapons across four different classes. 

Dragonkin: The Banished is available now for PlayStation 5 (PS5) and Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam).
title: Dragonkin: The Banished - Official Community Accolade Trailer | Nacon Connect 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Watch the latest Session: Skate Sim trailer to see what to expect with the Throwdowns update for the sports game, which brings new throwdown animations. Watch your skater naturally drop the board to the ground, pick it up, and flow seamlessly into tricks like never before. Session: Skate Sim is available now on PlayStation 5 (PS5), PlayStation 4 (PS4), Xbox Series X|S, Xbox One, and PC. The Throwdowns Update is live now.
title: Session: Skate Sim - Official Throwdowns Update Launch Trailer | Nacon Connect 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Get a deep dive into Tour de France 2026 in this latest trailer for the upcoming cycling simulation game, and get a breakdown of the new features. Tour de France 2026 features updated teams and routes, and climate changes that impact race management. Tour de France 2026 will be available on PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam and Epic Games Store) on June 4, 2026.
title: Tour de France 2026 - Official Overview Trailer | Nacon Connect 2026

author: GameTrailers
description:
Step into a dark new adventure. Check out the latest GreedFall: The Dying World trailer to see what you can expect with the Black Mass DLC, which continues your adventure on the continent of Gacane with an additional quest on Péren. 

Discover a brand new quest, along with a unique outfit and weapon. A troubling rumour spreads through Peren, where forbidden rituals are said to take place. Follow the trail of a corrupted faith and uncover a dangerous secret.

Help Cardinal Pius investigate the mysterious Black Masses, face the darkness, and explore how far the thirst for power can go.

GreedFall: The Dying World is available now for PC (Steam), PlayStation 5 (PS5), and Xbox Series X|S. The Peren Black Mass DLC is out now.
title: GreedFall: The Dying World - Official Peren's Black Mass DLC Trailer | Nacon Connect 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Hell is Us is coming to Nintendo Switch 2 on September 24, 2026. It is also available now on PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam and Epic Games Store). Check out the latest Hell is Us trailer for this action-adventure game. If war is the closest we get to hell on earth, it's because Earth harbours the worst of demons: humankind. In an isolated country ravaged by infighting, discover the secrets of your past and deal with the repercussions of a mysterious calamity.
title: Hell is Us - Official Nintendo Switch 2 Release Date Trailer | Nacon Connect 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Release Window Trailer for Gear.Club Unlimited 3, an arcade racing game developed by Eden Games. Players will race in a diverse set of locations from the French coast to Japan. Race with over 40 different cars, customize body styles, and go for first position on the track. Gear.Club Unlimited 3 is launching in October 2026 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam and Epic Games Store), with the game being available now on Nintendo Switch 2.
title: Gear.Club Unlimited 3 - Official Release Window | Nacon Connect 2026

description: Get another look at Cthulhu: The Cosmic Abyss in this trailer and see what critics are saying about the first-person Lovecraftian narrative-driven game. Cthulhu: The Cosmic Abyss is available now on PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X/S, and PC.
title: Cthulhu: The Cosmic Abyss - Official Accolade Trailer | Nacon Connect 2026

description: Don't miss ’The Royal Highlands’ Expansion Trailer for Palia, a free-to-play adventure RPG developed by Singularity 6 Corporation. Uncover the secrets of Amber Echo in The Royal Highlands Expansion for Palia, launching on May 12 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch, and PC (Steam).
title: Palia - Official ’The Royal Highlands’ Expansion Trailer

description:
Check out the Demo Launch Trailer for Project: Doors, a co-op first-person action-adventure game developed by Teletower Studios. Players will brave a sprawling maze with friends to evade traps, solve strange puzzles, and escape in one piece. Project: Doors is coming soon to PC (Steam), with a demo available now on Steam.

#ProjectDoors #Gaming #IGN
title: Project: Doors - Official Demo Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Game Overview Trailer for In Trusted Hands, a casual job simulation game developed by HGISoft. Players will find themselves at the head of a repair shop to fix people's phones in a bustling city. Make key decisions, handle the ramifications of knowing secrets through the repair process, and explore a winding narrative. In Trusted Hands is coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: In Trusted Hands - Official Game Overview Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Path of Exile 2: Return of the Ancients trailer for this upcoming update for the action RPG. Forgotten evils awaken in Path of Exile 2: Return of the Ancients! Path of Exile 2: Return of the Ancients features six new Endgame storylines, a new Challenge League, new Pinnacle Bosses, new crafting systems, new Ascendancy Classes, and new unique items. Path of Exile 2: Return of the Ancients will be available on PC, PlayStation 5 (PS5), and Xbox Series X/S on May 29, 2026.
title: Path of Exile 2: Return of the Ancients - Official Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the 'Deep in Ghost City' Gameplay Video for Exodus, an upcoming sci-fi third-person action-adventure RPG developed by Archetype Entertainment. Players can get a taste of the game's core combat and traversal with an encounter showcasing different weapons, elemental status effects, and more. Exodus is launching in Early 2027 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam and Epic Games Store).
title: Exodus - Official 'Deep in Ghost City' Gameplay Video

author: GameTrailers
description: Town to City will leave Early Access, and version 1.0 will be available on PC on May 26, 2026, alongside a new update. Watch the latest Town to City trailer to see what you can expect with the Tourism update for the city builder game, which brings a new destination and introduces new tourism mechanics, allowing you to plan tour routes between hotels and landmarks, and show off everything your idyllic town has to offer. With the new update, you will also be able to build a variety of hotels, from cozy boutique stays to grand luxury resorts. The update also adds new quests and jobs, a brand-new town, improved townsfolk animations, and plenty of quality-of-life improvements and bug fixes.
title: Town to City - Official 1.0 Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Paranoia Demo Launch Trailer for BrokenLore: Don’t Lie, a first-person psychological horror action game developed by Serafini Productions. Players will embody Junko as she tries to establish contact with two people she meant in a rehabilitation center. Witness her reality unravel in BrokenLore: Don’t Lie, coming to PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam) alongside a demo being available now on Steam.
title: BrokenLore: Don’t Lie - Official Paranoia Demo Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Get another look at Order of Wallachia in this latest trailer for the upcoming first-person action-adventure set in the medieval town of Kronstadt. Uncover dark secrets, battle Romanian folklore-inspired monsters, and fight back against the evil that plagues the land using various weaponry. Order of Wallachia will be available on PC, and a demo is out now on Steam.
title: Order of Wallachia - Official Demo Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Launch Trailer for Wardrum, a strategy turn-based roguelite developed by Mopeful Games. Players will explore an unforgiving fantasy world to take on the dark sorcery consuming the lands through tactical combat. Time attacks, strengthen the warriors that follow, and claim victory in Wardrum, available now for PC (Steam).
title: Wardrum - Official Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Launch Trailer for The Greenening, a wholesome nature-driven incremental idler developed by Erkberg Games. Players will awaken in a forgotten world covered in ashes. Wash away what remains to discover hidden secrets, upgrade water abilities, and grow a cozy space. The Greenening is available now for PC (Steam).
title: The Greenening - Official Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Hypnos is out now on Steam Early Access. It will be available at a later date on PlayStation and Xbox. Watch the Hypnos launch trailer for this first-person adventure and exploration game, set in a Lovecraftian megastructure fever dream. 

In Hypnos, enter the Nameless City at the edge of Dreams. Follow the trail into the shadow of the Holy Mountain. Wander through realms where the laws of the universe break down as they yield to other forces. Walk the Path and embrace your destiny.
title: Hypnos - Official Early Access Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Watch the latest Dreamcore trailer to see what to expect with Dead Mall, the fifth and final episode of the surreal body-cam psychological horror game. In Dreamcore, experience liminal spaces like never before. Dreamcore is a psychological exploration game, set in the largest liminal world ever made. No guides, no path—only intuition. Will you keep your bearings in a world designed to make you lose them? 

Dead Mall lets players loose on a nightmarish plaza with all the staples of childhood shopping, but contorted into an uncanny ordeal. Delve into its subliminal arcade, parking lot, food court, and bevy of isolated shops. 

Dreamcore is out now on PC, Xbox, and PlayStation. Dreamcore: Dead Mall will be available on May 21, 2026.
title: Dreamcore - Official Dead Mall Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Get a look at the Early Access Update 1 Launch Trailer for Ranger’s Path: National Park Simulator, a national park simulation game developed by To-Go Games. Players can now access a suite of new features and updates with new tasks across the park, alongside the Park Review Score system and a new off-road vehicle. The Early Access Update 1 for Ranger’s Path: National Park Simulator is available now for PC (Steam and Epic Games Store).
title: Ranger’s Path: National Park Simulator - Official Early Access Update 1 Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Nana Shimura DLC Character Trailer for My Hero Academia: All’s Justice, a 3D anime action fighting game developed by Byking Inc. Players can enter the ultimate battle as Nana Shimura, a hero from the past and former wielder of One For All. End the competition as Nana Shimura, available now in My Hero Academia: All’s Justice for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam).
title: My Hero Academia: All’s Justice - Official Nana Shimura DLC Character Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Take a look at the Drill Deep announcement trailer for this upcoming coalpunk Lovecraftian roguelite clicker game from the developer behind Salty Dogs and Lost Railway. Drill Deep will be available on Steam in 2026.

In Drill Deep, descend into the Mine time after time to mine coal, ore, whatever else the earth is hiding there. Remember to work fast: soon the corruption will take hold of you, your canary and all the operation on the surface. At this point, take what you managed to unearth and use it to craft permanent upgrades for the next run. The cycle begins anew and you descend once again. Maybe this time you’ll be able to last at least a minute.
title: Drill Deep - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Witness the unwavering devotion of the Adeptus Mechanicus. Check out the latest Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War 4 trailer for this upcoming real-time strategy game to get a deep dive into the Adeptus Mechanicus faction. Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War 4 will be available on Steam in 2026.

Replacing flesh with machine, and seeking forbidden knowledge, The Adeptus Mechanicus are not merely engineers or scientists… but a procession dedicated to war. Every calculation, every cybernetic action, all in service to, and guided by The Machine God. 

From the disciplined ranks of the Skitarii Rangers cutting down enemies from the firing lines, to the towering might of the Knight Castelan capable of annihiliating all who oppose the will of the Omnissiah, the Adeptus Mechanicus bring their relentless efficiency to the battlefield. 

Supported by some of the most advanced structures among the factions, the Adeptus Mechanicus establish a growing stronghold across Kronos, with their ever-expanding Noos
title: Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War 4 - Official Adeptus Mechanicus Faction Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Accolades Trailer for Invincible VS, the hit 3v3 tag fighting game based on the comic book and Amazon Prime series developed by Quarter Up. Players will take on the biggest names in the Invincible universe, from Omni-Man, Conquest, Allen the Alien, Atom Eve, and Invincible himself in intense action-packed battles. Check out the critical reception behind Invincible VS, available now for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Xbox Cloud, and PC (Steam and Xbox on PC).
title: Invincible VS - Official Accolades Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Watch the Accolades Trailer for Tides of Tomorrow, a first-person multiplayer narrative-driven game developed by Digixart. Players will play out the consequences of the actions done by other players in a world that hangs in the balance after being flooded. Make key choices, meet a unique cast, and decide the fate of the ocean planet that's been brought to its knees by a disease. Don't miss the critical reception behind Tides of Tomorrow, available now for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam).
title: Tides of Tomorrow - Official Accolades Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Take a look at the Glory on Pluto announcement trailer for this upcoming strategy game about building a rocket engine that absolutely refuses to behave. The Glory on Pluto trailer showcases gameplay and what you can expect. Glory on Pluto will be available on PC in 2026, and a demo is out now on Steam.

Set on a journey to reach the galaxy’s most famous dwarf planet, Glory On Pluto challenges players to construct and optimise a circular engine made up of fuels, crew and modifiers, all working together (or not) to propel their ship forward as far – and as chaotically – as possible.
title: Glory on Pluto - Official Demo Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Here's your look at the Dupery announcement trailer for this upcoming single-player investigation roguelite game, which takes the thrill of social deduction games into a tightly designed puzzle of lies, contradictions, and deceit for solo players. Dupery will be available on PC in 2026, and a demo is out now on Steam.

A terrible syndicate has infiltrated society, so players explore cases, listen to what the citizens have to say and use that information to root out the wrong ‘uns. Over the course of their investigations, detectives must gather clues, question suspects and piece together conflicting information to identify hidden roles within a criminal syndicate. 

The problem? Not everything revealed is true.
title: Dupery - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Infinity Sweeper is available now on Steam. Watch the Infinity Sweeper launch trailer for this retro puzzle roguelike game inspired by Minesweeper.

Infinity Sweeper combines classic strategy and nostalgia with the replayability of modern roguelikes. Carefully navigate the familiar grid, uncovering the numbered tiles while avoiding the destructive mines. Use your wit to uncover patterns in the grid that indicate the placement of safe tiles, and flag mine tiles to avoid wasting one of your three precious lives. Prepare to overcome Infinity Sweeper’s ever-expanding grid, where one wrong move can set you back to the start.
title: Infinity Sweeper - Official Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Curators, compose yourselves, it’s time for clay-os… Watch the Two Point Museum: Arty-Facts launch trailer for this creatively inspired DLC. The Arty-Facts DLC will feature a new museum location called Undee Docks, new Art Experts, an unexplored expedition map through Zara’s Sketchbook, 27+ art exhibits including Famous Works, new gift shop items, new themed cafe items, five new interactive displays, new themed items and decorations, and a new Art Studio room to create original art pieces.

Two Point: Museum's Arty-Facts DLC is available now on PC, Xbox X|S, and PlayStation 5 (PS5). It is coming soon to Nintendo Switch 2.
title: Two Point Museum: Arty-Facts - Official Launch Trailer

description:
We're excited to announce that our May IGN First "cover story" is on Aliens: Fireteam Elite 2 from Cold Iron and Daybreak Games. You can look forward to several exclusive new reveals on IGN channels spread throughout the month of May, starting with tomorrow's AFE2 trailer premiere and official announcement!

#IGN #Aliens

description: Take a look at the Dragon’s Claim Event Trailer for The Finals, a first-person multiplayer shooter developed by Embark Studios. Dodge the dragon in the Dragon’s Claim Event for The Finals, available now for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam).
title: The Finals - Official Dragon’s Claim Event Trailer

description:
Check out the LEGO Batman: Legacy of the Dark Knight launch trailer for this upcoming action-adventure game. The new trailer showcases cinematics and gameplay. Watch as Batman, Robin, Nightwing, Batgirl, Jim Gordon, Catwoman and Talia al Ghul take on DC super villains, including The Joker, Poison Ivy, Mr. Freeze, Two-Face, Ra’s al Ghul, Bane, and more. LEGO Batman: Legacy of the Dark Knight will be available on PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam & Epic Games Store) on May 22, 2026. Deluxe Edition pre-orders will receive 72-hour early access beginning on May 19, 2026.

#LEGOBatmanLegacyOfTheDarkKnight #IGN #Gaming
title: LEGO Batman: Legacy of the Dark Knight - Official Launch Trailer

description: Check out the 30th Anniversary Trailer for Ace Combat 7: Skies Unknown, the latest installment in the jet dogfighting action game developed by Project Aces. Players can get a thrilling look at the 2019 title, packed with enhanced and realistic handling, extensive aircraft options, and unprecedented speed in the skies. Ace Combat 7: Skies Unknown is available now for PlayStation 4 (PS4), Xbox One, Nintendo Switch, and PC (Steam).
title: Ace Combat 7: Skies Unknown - Official 30th Anniversary Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Playtest Trailer for Salty Dogs, a 2D aquatic physics-based action game developed by Crossbridge Game Studios. Players will lead a brave submarine crew to the depths of the great ocean to find loot, protect the submarine's integrity, and ascend before oxygen depletes. Salty Dogs is coming soon to PC (Steam), with a playtest available now on Steam.
title: Salty Dogs - Official Playtest Trailer

description: Take a look at the Cosmetic Update Launch Trailer for R.E.P.O., an online co-op horror game developed by Semiwork. Players can now gain access to a suite of new cosmetics with over 500 different items to unlock and customize. The Cosmetic Update for R.E.P.O. is available now for PC (Steam).
title: R.E.P.O. - Official Cosmetic Update Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Mixtape is available now on Nintendo Switch 2, Steam, Epic Games Store, PlayStation 5 (PS5), and Xbox Series X/S. 

Watch the Mixtape launch trailer for this adventure game. Make out. Sneak out. Hang out. On their last night together, three friends embark on one final adventure. Play through a mixtape of memories, set to the soundtrack of a generation.
title: Mixtape - Official Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: WILL: Follow the Light is available now on PC (Epic Games Store and Steam), Xbox Series X/S, and PlayStation 5 (PS5). Watch the WILL: Follow the Light launch trailer for this adventure game. Dive into a realistic, single-player, first-person journey through the harsh northern latitudes as you sail endless waters, searching for a way back to your loved ones. Will you follow the light?
title: WILL: Follow the Light - Official Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Console Release Date Trailer for Hollowbody, a third-person action survival game developed by Headware Games. Players will embody Mica on a sinister adventure to locate her missing partner. Manage resources, engage in tense fights, and solve puzzles to escape beyond the wall. Hollowbody is launching on June 5 for PlayStation 5 (PS5) and Xbox Series X|S, with the game being available now on PC (Steam).
title: Hollowbody - Official Console Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Mad King Redemption gets a new trailer showcasing action-packed gameplay and an early access release date announcement. Check out the Mad King Redemption early access release date trailer for this upcoming side-scrolling beat 'em up game. Mad King Redemption will be available in Early Access on Steam, GOG, and the Epic Game Store on May 14, 2026.

Mad King Redemption is a love letter to the Golden Age of beat 'em ups. Designed for both veterans and new players, the game delivers high-intensity, short-session gameplay that recaptures the thrill of classic 8-bit and 16-bit brawlers. Featuring a 2D/3D pixel art style, Steam co-op, local co-op play, and a unique feature called Corruption, that grants players special abilities that will make them stronger … but corrupted power comes at a price.
title: Mad King Redemption - Official Early Access Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at gameplay in this new trailer for Totopia, an upcoming free-to-play multiplayer party game. Totopia is calling! Drip in your style and crush 100+ chaotic maps, or smash the Bitrot crisis with Atomon skills! Need a recharge? Visit Pulse Avenue to build, plant, or run a cozy cafe. Cast your fishline, chill, and vibe with quirky Atomons. Your world, your way—join the squad and catch that W! Totopia will be available on PC and Xbox Series X/S.
title: Totopia - Official Extended Gameplay Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Duck Side of the Moon is available now on PC (Steam and Epic Games Store) and Nintendo Switch. Watch the Duck Side of the Moon launch trailer for this cozy exploration and crafting adventure game. 

After crash-landing in a strange but charming galaxy, Doug the duck sets out on a journey to gather resources, build gadgets, upgrade his spaceship, and discover that life among the stars might not be as stressful as it was quacked up to be.

In the process of helping the friendly inhabitants of a tiny planet, he learns more about himself. A short but wholesome adventure that teaches you it's OK to slow down.
title: Duck Side of the Moon - Official Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Warriors Event Trailer World of Tanks Modern Armor, a free-to-play multiplayer tank game developed by Wargaming. Players will have the opportunity to rise to the occasion to overcome a series of challenges in the all-new Battle Bracket, a community-driven tournament where every match counts. Earn a variety of rewards in the Warriors Event for World of Tanks Modern Armor, running from May 12 through June 1 on PlayStation 4 (PS4), PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox One, and Xbox Series X|S.
title: World of Tanks Modern Armor - Official Warriors Event Trailer
